posts.author: Anthony's Stormy World ⚡️🌎
posts.text:
Gonna run with this now 12z ECM update... #StormAusten looks certain to be a Major Atlantic storm... 24hrs out from impacts begining it looks like a powerful storm for Jersey, Nw France, far Sw England  and scilly.
Watching for Strong winds and big waves into south coast.

posts.author: Sausiuswx
posts.text: While excact details still need ironing out, I think I can now say with good confidence that hurricane force gusts are likely in large parts of Cornwall, the channel islands and coastal regions of France from Brittany through at least haute-normandie from Storm Austen

posts.author: Nick's Weather Eye
posts.text: The first named-storm of the 2026-27 season, #StormAusten, will cross S England on Friday morning - bringing risk of disruptive winds across SW England, Channel Islands and northern France, 50-60mph widely here, but 70mph+ gusts possible with exposure.  Winds easing early
